fields.name: use_tls
fields.label: Use STARTTLS
fields.description: Use port 587 for STARTTLS. Implicit TLS on port 465 is not supported.

fields.name: smtp_username
fields.label: SMTP username
fields.description: Usually your full email address. Leave empty for an unauthenticated relay.

fields.name: smtp_password
fields.label: SMTP password or app password
fields.description: Encrypted on the server. Existing passwords are masked.

fields.name: imap_enabled
fields.label: Read incoming mail (IMAP)
fields.description: New messages in the folder below become Communication documents. The mailbox is only read: nothing is deleted, moved or marked as read.

fields.name: imap_starttls
fields.label: Use STARTTLS (port 143) instead of TLS from the start (port 993)
fields.description: The connection is always encrypted; unencrypted IMAP is not supported.

fields.name: imap_password
fields.label: IMAP password or app password
fields.description: Encrypted on the server. Existing passwords are masked.

fields.name: site_url
fields.label: Public site URL
fields.description: Used for password-reset links. For example https://desk.example.com

validations.message: SMTP port must be between 1 and 65535.
IMAP port must be between 1 and 65535.
Enter a password when SMTP authentication is used.
